Tools let an agent do things during a call instead of only talking.

## Google Workspace

Connect a Google account under **Integrations** to give your agents:

- **Google Calendar** — check availability and create, move or cancel events.
- **Google Sheets** — look up rows (prices, stock, opening hours) or log each call as a new row.
- **Gmail (send only)** — send a summary or confirmation email set up in your workflow.

LightMove.ai only requests the access each integration needs. You can disconnect at any time. See the [Privacy Policy](/privacy) for how Google data is handled.

## Webhooks

Call your own systems from a workflow step. The agent sends the details it has collected and can use the response in the conversation, for example to check an order status.

## Adding a tool to a step

Open a workflow step, choose **Add tool**, pick the integration and describe when the agent should use it. Test it with a call and check the run log to see the tool's input and output.
